name: @snow-the/dsh-notemap
description: Networked knowledge graph for DeepSeek Harness: infinite canvas of notes with quantified relations (weights/confidence), graph algorithms (BFS/DFS/Dijkstra/centrality/common-neighbors/PageRank), DuckLake-inspired snapshots + change streams, cytoscape-compatible JSON export.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --emitDeclarationOnly && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.js --external:@deepseek-ai/* --log-level=warning && esbuild web/components.js --bundle --format=esm --outfile=web/lit.bundle.js --log-level=warning
